output:

    self_contained: true

<script>
// Capture every wrapper event for the Playwright specs.
document.addEventListener('gsm-viz-select', function (e) {
  (window.__gsmEvents = window.__gsmEvents || []).push(e.detail);
});
</script>

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(gsm.vizr)
```

## Basic vertical stack (count)

<div id="page-basic">
```{r basic}
dfSites <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S-001", "S-002", "S-003"), times = c(5, 3, 2)),
  flag = rep(c("2", "1", "2", "1", "0"), times = 2)
)
bars(dfSites, list(mapping = list(x = "site", fill = "flag")),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-basic")
)
```
</div>

## Single-level factors (order arrays of length one)

<div id="page-singleton">
```{r singleton}
# One level on both aesthetics is the case auto_unbox would collapse to
# "order":"S1". Upstream then calls explicitOrder.filter() on a string and dies
# with an uncaught TypeError, so the chart is blank and R reports nothing. This
# page is the browser-side proof that .normalize_spec_arrays() prevents it.
dfSingle <- data.frame(
  site = factor("S-001", levels = "S-001"),
  flag = factor("2", levels = "2")
)
bars(dfSingle, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-singleton")
)
```
</div>

## Facet dispatch

<div id="page-facet">
```{r facet}
# Guards the facet branch of the binding: bars() and facet_bars() share one
# htmlwidget, so the only thing routing to facetBars is the presence of the
# facet payload slot. Later tasks edit this binding repeatedly.
dfFacet <- data.frame(
  site = rep(c("S-001", "S-002"), 4),
  flag = rep(c("2", "1"), each = 4),
  country = rep(c("USA", "CAN"), each = 4)
)
facet_bars(dfFacet, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag"),
  facet_spec("country", nCol = 2),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-facet")
)
```
</div>

## js_hook tooltip formatter

<div id="page-hooks">
```{r hooks}
bars(
  dfSites,
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", fill = "flag",
    tooltip = list(formatter = js_hook(
      "function (value, context, details) { return 'Subjects: ' + value; }"
    ))
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-hooks")
)
```
</div>

## Selection enabled (click-to-select)

<div id="page-select">
```{r select}
bars(
  dfSites,
  bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag", selection = list(enabled = TRUE)),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-select", level = "site")
)
```
</div>

## Selection on a pre-aggregated (identity) chart

<div id="page-select-identity">
```{r select-identity}
# Same event contract, different `datum` shape. Upstream sets point._datum to
# the single contributing row under stat "identity" (structureData.js) but to
# the array of aggregated rows under stat "count" (aggregateCounts.js). The
# wrapper forwards it unchanged, so both shapes reach consumers and both are
# asserted in events.spec.js.
dfIdentity <- data.frame(
  site = c("S-001", "S-002"),
  n = c(5, 3),
  flag = c("2", "1")
)
bars(
  dfIdentity,
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", y = "n", fill = "flag", stat = "identity",
    selection = list(enabled = TRUE)
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-select-identity", level = "site")
)
```
</div>

## Dynamic sizing with the minHeight floor (2 categories)

<div id="page-dynamic">
```{r dynamic}
bars(
  data.frame(site = c("S1", "S2"), n = c(4, 2)),
  bars_spec(
    x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity", orientation = "horizontal",
    theme = list(dynamicSizing = TRUE)
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-dynamic")
)
```
</div>

## Horizontal stack, identity, named colors, captions

<div id="page-hbar">
```{r hbar}
dfFlags <- data.frame(
  invid = factor(rep(c("INV-3", "INV-1", "INV-2"), each = 2),
    levels = c("INV-3", "INV-1", "INV-2")
  ),
  flag = factor(rep(c("2", "1"), times = 3), levels = c("2", "1")),
  n = c(5, 2, 4, 1, 2, 2)
)
bars(dfFlags,
  bars_spec(
    x = "invid", y = "n", fill = "flag",
    orientation = "horizontal", stat = "identity",
    scales = list(fill = list(colors = c(`2` = "#c91b1d", `1` = "#fdb84c"))),
    labels = list(captions = c("Footnote line 1.", "Footnote line 2."))
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-hbar-stack")
)
```
</div>

## Dodge / 100% fill / percent

<div id="page-positions">
```{r positions}
bars(dfSites, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag", position = "dodge"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-dodge")
)
bars(dfSites, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag", position = "fill"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-fill100")
)
bars(dfSites, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag", stat = "percent"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-percent")
)
```
</div>

## Identity single series + frequency sort + Top-N

<div id="page-ordering">
```{r ordering}
dfCounts <- data.frame(site = sprintf("S-%02d", 1:8), n = c(9, 3, 7, 1, 5, 2, 8, 4))
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity"),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-identity")
)
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(
  x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity",
  scales = list(x = list(sort = "total", sortDir = "desc"))
),
metadata = list(chartId = "chart-sort-total")
)
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity", nCategories = 3),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-topn")
)
```
</div>

## Labels, tooltips, reference lines, zoom, dense legend, multi-select

<div id="page-extras">
```{r extras}
bars(dfFlags,
  bars_spec(
    x = "invid", y = "n", fill = "flag", stat = "identity",
    annotations = list(labels = list(
      segment = list(display = TRUE),
      total = list(display = TRUE)
    ))
  ),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-seg-labels")
)
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(
  x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity",
  tooltip = list(format = ",d")
),
metadata = list(chartId = "chart-tooltip-format")
)
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(
  x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity",
  annotations = list(referenceLines = list(
    list(value = 5, label = "Threshold", color = "#c91b1d")
  ))
),
metadata = list(chartId = "chart-reflines")
)
bars(dfCounts, bars_spec(
  x = "site", y = "n", stat = "identity",
  zoom = list(enabled = TRUE)
),
metadata = list(chartId = "chart-zoom")
)
bars(dfSites, bars_spec(x = "site", fill = "flag", legend = list(dense = TRUE)),
  metadata = list(chartId = "chart-dense-legend")
)
bars(dfSites, bars_spec(
  x = "site", fill = "flag",
  selection = list(enabled = TRUE, multiple = TRUE)
),
metadata = list(chartId = "chart-multi-select")
)
```
</div>
